prompt: List each item in this RSS feed with its title, pubDate, and a one-sentence summary of the description. Limit to the most recent 20 items.

This is JSON row data from the LMArena (Chatbot Arena) text leaderboard's official Hugging Face dataset (lmarena-ai/leaderboard-dataset, config 'text', split 'latest'), already filtered to the 'overall' category and sorted by rank ascending. List each row's rank, model_name, organization and rating (round rating to the nearest integer).

List each Oracle JDK version with its release date, Premier Support end date, and Extended Support end date (if any). Call out which versions are already past end-of-life as of today, and which are within 6 months of it. Also summarize the Premier/Extended/Sustaining support-tier policy described on the page.

List each Eclipse Temurin (OpenJDK) version with its release date and support-end date. Call out which versions are already past end-of-life and which are within 6 months of it. Summarize the release-cadence/support-policy notes on the page (6-month releases, LTS every 2 years, community backporting).

List each Amazon Corretto version with its release date and support-end date. Call out which versions are already past end-of-life and which are within 6 months of it. Summarize any support-policy notes (e.g. extended support for specific versions).
